environment.database: temporary PostgreSQL 17 cluster, loopback only, PR486 Prisma migrations
environment.transport: real Fastify HTTP, real Prisma repositories and locally signed synthetic route/account JWTs
environment.office: actual PR328 Shopify BFF helpers with authenticated synthetic session
environment.mobile: actual driver API clients, live-change controller/domain store and offline submission queue
environment.persistence: production domain store using atomic temporary file adapter and store recreation
environment.providers: disabled; no real push, geocoding, payment or store access

checks.name: Actual Shopify BFF Save is private to the office; mobile GET remains at the baseline publication
Dispatch creates pending state; actual refresh controller retains original content and gates missing local baseline recovery
Explicit Apply uses exact immutable N; N+1 published during ACK keeps the banner and does not silently replace applied N
Lost ACK response retains durable applied snapshot and exact ACK identity; new store instance safely retries without cross-account or generation state
Actual offline queue submits unchanged stop 2 evidence with its original clientEventId, generation, publication and payload; server accepts it
Changed stop 7 evidence reaches authoritative server validation and remains quarantined with its original identity after rejection
A reordered target rejects old-publication evidence through the same actual queue/API path
Non-enrolled queue behavior, route-level evidence and wrong generations remain blocked; wrong-generation ACK is rejected by real HTTP server
Execution refresh advances delivered status while preserving applied addresses and order until the next explicit Apply
Explicit Apply accepts the new future order and clears pending while preserving completion, proof drafts and monetary fields

limitations: This run does not render React Native UI or replace physical-device acceptance.
The file adapter proves domain-store restart behavior; native SQLCipher and SecureStore need device tests.
Push delivery, background OS lifecycle, live Shopify authentication and provider routing are not exercised.
cleanup: Fastify, Prisma and temporary PostgreSQL are closed and temporary fixture/state files removed in finally
